parent.heading: Grown-ups
parent.keepers.intro: Up to four children can play on this device. Each has their own dragons, progress and settings.
parent.keepers.none: No keepers yet. Add one to start.
parent.keepers.removeBody: This deletes {name}'s dragons, progress and settings on this device. Save a backup first if you may want them back.
parent.keepers.removeFailed: Could not remove {name}. Nothing else changed. Try again.
parent.settings.none: Add a keeper to change their settings.
parent.settings.notation.czech.spoken: Czech school: a dot for times, a colon for divided by, small r for remainder
parent.settings.notation.international.s: International: a cross for times, a division sign for divided by, capital R for remainder
parent.settings.voiceSample: Fifty-six divided by seven equals eight.
parent.settings.noVoice: No offline English voice is installed, so read-aloud is hidden. Dragon Valley only uses voices on this device. No text leaves the device. Install an English system voice to turn it on.
parent.settings.failed: That setting could not be saved, so nothing changed. Try again.
parent.data.backupIntro: A backup file holds one keeper: name, picture, progress and settings. Keep it somewhere safe; you can load it here or on another device.
parent.data.exported: Backup of {name} saved as a file.
parent.data.exportFailed: {name}'s latest progress is not saved yet, so a backup now could miss something. Fix the save first, then try again.
parent.data.importFailed: That file is not a Dragon Valley backup this version can load. Nothing was changed.
parent.data.importConfirmBody: This will replace {name}'s dragons, progress and settings on this device with the ones in the file.
parent.data.resetBody: This erases {name}'s dragons and progress on this device only. Settings and any backup files stay. It cannot be undone.
parent.data.persisted: The browser has promised to keep saved progress.
parent.data.notPersisted: The browser may clear saved progress if the device runs low on space. Backups keep it safe.
parent.data.persistUnknown: This browser does not say whether it keeps saved progress.
parent.data.persist: Ask the browser to keep progress
parent.offline.heading: Play without internet
parent.offline.intro: Installing copies the whole game to this device, so it also works with no connection. Saved progress is separate. Installing or removing offline files does not delete it.
parent.offline.ready: Installed. Dragon Valley works offline on this device.
parent.offline.missing: Not installed for offline play yet.
parent.offline.failed: Installation did not finish ({code}). Nothing was changed. Try again.
parent.offline.unavailable: This browser cannot install Dragon Valley for offline play. A recent browser on a secure web page can.
parent.offline.updateReady: An update was downloaded. It starts the next time Dragon Valley opens, never in the middle of a game.
parent.about.privacy: Dragon Valley has no accounts, ads, purchases, links out or tracking. Progress stays on this device.
parent.about.font: Text uses DV Reading, based on Andika by SIL Global. It is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
parent.progress.none: Add a keeper to see their progress here.
parent.progress.unreadable: {name}'s saved game could not be opened here. Open it from the keepers screen to see what happened.
parent.progress.notYet: {name} has not answered any problems yet. Progress shows up here after the first activity.
parent.progress.windowIntro: Every fact is a pane of glass. It turns bronze, then silver, then gold as your child answers it correctly and quickly. A sparkle marks a known fact that is due for practice again.
parent.progress.mulCaption: Multiplication: the row number times the column number
parent.progress.divCaption: Division: rows are divisors; columns are quotients.
parent.progress.mulGrid: Multiplication facts: {gold} gold, {silver} silver, {bronze} bronze, {dim} still dark.
parent.progress.divGrid: Division facts: {gold} gold, {silver} silver, {bronze} bronze, {dim} still dark.
parent.progress.tablesNote: Each table counts its multiplication facts in both orders. Right and quick answers are percentages of the answers for that table; quick answers show fluency.
parent.progress.trendNone: {name} has not practised in the last {span} days.
parent.progress.trendDays.one: {name} practised on 1 of the last {span} days.
parent.progress.trendDays.other: {name} practised on {count} of the last {span} days.
parent.progress.trendTable: Show the days as a list
parent.progress.skillsShow: Show the {count} skills practised so far
parent.item.div2d1d.regroup: Two-digit divided by one-digit, with regrouping
parent.item.div2d1d.noregroup: Two-digit divided by one-digit, without regrouping
parent.item.compare.fact-number: Comparing a fact with a number
parent.print.intro: Print practice cards and certificates on A4 paper. The pages are made on this device; nothing is sent anywhere.
parent.print.cardsIntro: Ten cards to a sheet: the problem on the front, the answer on the back.
parent.print.noHardest: Flashcards of the hardest facts appear here once there are some to practise.
parent.print.cardsGuidance: Print on A4 at 100 % (actual size), on both sides, flipping on the long edge, with headers and footers turned off. Then cut along the dashed lines.
parent.print.noCertificates: Certificates appear here when {name} crowns a dragon or wins over a region's boss.
parent.print.certificateGuidance: Print on A4 at 100 % (actual size), on one side, with headers and footers turned off.
parent.print.failed: That could not be laid out on paper, so nothing was printed.
print.certificate.dragonTable: helped {dragon} learn the whole {table} times table.
print.certificate.dragonSpecial: helped {dragon} grow all the way to a crown.
print.certificate.finale: cured all seven heads of the Seven-Headed Dragon.
recovery.heading: Saved data needs a grown-up
recovery.family: The list of keepers on this device could not be opened.
recovery.game: {name}'s saved game could not be opened.
recovery.content: It was saved with an older version of the game, which this device could not load. Connect to the internet, then try opening it again.
recovery.unavailable: The browser is not letting Dragon Valley use its storage. Private windows often do this.
recovery.export: Save the stored data to a file
recovery.previous: Go back to the previous copy
recovery.resetBody: This cannot be undone. Save the stored data to a file first if you might need it.
recovery.failed: That did not work, so the saved data was not changed.
